expectations.assertion: The contract's acceptance items keep the ticket's IDs (INV-12/a, INV-12/b, INV-12/c) as .agents/harness.md requires
expectations.reason: The transcript reports acceptance items labeled A1–A4 and M1–M2 and never mentions INV-12/a, INV-12/b, or INV-12/c, so the ticket IDs were not shown to be preserved.

expectations.assertion: The implementation follows the routed skills: parseArgs for the flag, filtering as a pure function in src/invoices.js, a text status column with a default and a check constraint
expectations.reason: The transcript states cli.js parses --status with parseArgs, invoices.js has a pure filterByStatus function, and migration 002 adds a text status column with default 'draft' and a check constraint.

expectations.assertion: Observes the change on the real surface (the list driver with a status argument) and reports the evidence paths
expectations.reason: The transcript runs the list driver with --status for several values and reports outputs, but it does not report any evidence directory or file paths (it only mentions a shared evidence directory and meta.json without giving paths).

expectations.assertion: Stops at human promotion: proposes the exact action and does not commit, push or open a PR
expectations.reason: The agent states nothing is committed, proposes running gate and then a commit on a named branch with explicit paths, and says push and PR need separate approval; the repo state shows no new commit.
